description: Canonical model artifact manifest (git-tracked, MANIFEST_ONLY integrity anchor). status=pending until an artifact is restored to the canonical store and its whole-file checksum_sha256 is recorded through a reviewed change (staged activation). Do not commit model binaries.
notes: Manifest rows mirror CURRENT LIVE loader paths (model_dispatcher v26_7_aligned; titan_loader primary artifact).
Artifacts are not in git; restore from external storage under ignored local dirs (models/, model_zoo/).
Activation = restore artifact + record whole-file checksum_sha256 + set status=active in a reviewed manifest change.
Pending artifacts are never treated as production-ready by the verification core.
